omission.chore: Check that custom app order attributes remain available when a client migrates a Shopify storefront from a custom theme to Hydrogen.
omission.evidenceQuote: I’ve not seen this break in practice when migrating a client from a custom theme to Hydrogen — the attribute was on the order, not the renderer.
omission.reason: The retained context describes client migration work and a concrete check of whether custom app order attributes persist across storefronts; the rejection dismissed it as implementation observations without assessing this bounded chore.
